sources.summary: Los Angeles studio Waka Waka has designed Ribbon, an undulating furniture collection made from steel and aluminium decorated with saturated colours, for Japanese manufacturer Benex's Eetal project. Eetal, which presented a selection of sheet-metal furniture during design festival 3 Days of Design in Copenhagen this year, commissions designers to find uses for Benex's aluminium and steel The post Waka Waka curls colourful metal into curved shapes for Ribbon furniture collection appeared first on Dezeen .
